orientation.trait_coverage: 19/38 source concepts resolved in the Japan38 authority seed; JPN_20 and JPN_31 are excluded from the current trait tree for independent reasons
orientation.evolutionary_history: Japan38 compatibility ML tree requires 6 unordered steps; across UFBoot1000 the lower bound is 4-6 with median 5, and the minimum-change root state is U in all 1000 topologies
orientation.transition_identifiability: The repeated-state lower bound is robust but branch localization is weak: the ML minimum reconstruction has zero individually forced orientation-change edges; the most frequent terminal forced edge is JPN_36 in only 20.1% of bootstrap topologies
orientation.ecology: present-day BIO15/BIO1 candidate and branchwise direction implemented, but ecological event alignment must wait for better transition localization
orientation.functional_prior: external manipulation supports abiotic-protection / reproductive-fitness pathway
orientation.status: benchmark module with robust recurrence but unresolved transition placement; not sole programme focus

display.broad_direct_seed: 15 source-backed direct size rows compiled across Japan/Ryukyu/Taiwan
display.japan38_direct_coverage: 5/38 exact Japan38 concepts (13.2%) have directly comparable source-backed involucre_live_diameter values: JPN_03 Cirsium alpicola, JPN_09 C. gyojanum, JPN_19 C. nippoense, JPN_30 C. yezoense, JPN_37 C. kamtschaticum
display.comparability_gate: Only the five exact Japan38 involucre_live_diameter rows form one directly comparable metric family. Cirsium suffultum is not mapped to JPN_24 C. pseudosuffultum; infraspecific taxa are not collapsed to species-level concepts; measured capitulum length/width and involucre diameter are not discretized into one state merely to increase coverage.
display.head_number: qualitative architecture available for some taxa but standardized plant-level simultaneous/seasonal head count remains missing
display.functional_prior: pollinator-benefit and reproductive-enemy-cost evidence both available
display.pilot_result: direct measured capitulum width has no detectable U/D coupling in the seven-taxon PGLS diagnostic
display.next_measurement: Prioritize standardized direct capitulum/involucre size for JPN_36 C. sieboldii, JPN_06 C. dipsacolepis, JPN_34 C. microspicatum, JPN_15 C. lineare and JPN_24 C. pseudosuffultum; keep head number as a separate display variable.
display.status: not ready for Japan38-wide evolutionary-history mapping: exact directly comparable coverage is 5/38, so discretization/ASR would add assumptions faster than information

phyllary_spine.trait_coverage: Japan38 NMNS phyllary posture resolved for 10 concepts; direct phyllary length/protrusion measurements compiled for seven focal taxa
phyllary_spine.evolutionary_history: minimum 3 unordered steps on the Japan38 ML tree and exactly 3 on all UFBoot1000 topologies; minimum-change root remains ambiguous among ascending/spreading/recurved
phyllary_spine.transition_identifiability: JPN_36 is the only forced terminal change on the ML minimum reconstruction and is forced in 75.4% of bootstrap topologies; the dominant remaining uncertainty is ancestral-state identity rather than the minimum step count
phyllary_spine.functional_prior: defence plausible but focal trait-to-enemy-to-fitness effect not resolved
phyllary_spine.pilot_result: phyllary protrusion is smaller in D taxa in the seven-taxon PGLS diagnostic (borderline p~0.055), but lineage confounding prevents ecological interpretation
phyllary_spine.status: repeated history is supported; functional loading and denser trait coverage remain blocked

stickiness.trait_coverage: Japan38 NMNS sticky/nonsticky state resolved for 12 concepts
stickiness.evolutionary_history: minimum 5 unordered steps on the ML tree; UFBoot1000 gives 4-5 with median 5; minimum root is sticky in 670/1000 topologies and ambiguous sticky/nonsticky in 330/1000
stickiness.transition_identifiability: ML minimum reconstruction forces changes on JPN_06, JPN_36 and one larger clade; across bootstrap topologies JPN_06 is forced in 67.0% and JPN_36 in 40.0%
stickiness.mk_warning: branch-length-aware equal-rates Mk is saturation-prone for stickiness (k*q*median branch about 4.48; prior change probability about 0.494)
stickiness.functional_prior: direct Cirsium neutralization result weakens generic defence hypothesis
stickiness.status: useful macroevolutionary negative-control module; do not promote current Mk overlap to shared developmental mechanism

colour.japan38_exhaustive_continuous_bridge: exact-concept continuous colour metrics recovered for 14/38 Japan38 concepts from the Azami strict-spatial exhaustive cohort; 17/38 paper concepts are represented at binomial level when JPN_12 and JPN_20/JPN_21 broad-species sensitivities are counted
colour.evidence_depth: 5 exact concepts have at least 10 colour-usable observations (JPN_17, JPN_23, JPN_36, JPN_37, JPN_38); the remaining 9 exact concepts are sparse or very sparse
colour.history_gate: A row-level exact continuous bridge now exists, but no discrete C/W state ontology is frozen. JPN_12 var. horridum and JPN_20/JPN_21 nipponicum varieties are not assigned broad-species phenotypes.
colour.functional_prior: pollinator preference and abiotic-pigment hypotheses remain context dependent
colour.next_action: Run a continuous-trait phylogenetic pilot with observation-count/dispersion sensitivity. Do not discretize hue/chroma/lightness merely to enter the three-module Sankoff/Mk overlap analysis; fixed-white lineage recovery remains necessary for directional loss/regain questions.
colour.status: continuous-history pilot is now possible with uncertainty caution; discrete transition-history module remains gated

cross_module.current_h2_h3_resolution: No module pair is consistently positive across the branch-length-aware and branch-length-free topology layers. The simple H3 alternative of one shared whole-capitulum lability axis is therefore not supported by the current three-module data. This makes module-specific histories necessary, but does not by itself establish developmental/genetic modular evolvability (H2). Display is not counted as a fourth historical module because direct comparable size coverage is 5/38. Colour now has a 14/38 exact continuous bridge, but is not inserted into the discrete Sankoff/Mk overlap test because no frozen discrete colour-state ontology exists.
cross_module.interpretation: Repeated evolution is supported within each of the three currently mapped modules, while cross-module coupling is assumption-sensitive and heterogeneous. Retain separate module histories rather than collapsing capitulum variation onto one latent lability axis.

trait_completion_design.criterion: multi-objective, topology-conditioned and identity-gated design: prefer a missing state that robustly reduces optional transition-placement edges; if none exists, target ancestral-state discrimination, then minimum-step falsification. Enumerated hypothetical states are scenarios, not probabilities.

orientation.note: JPN_33 has the largest raw localization gain but is not operationally first because its cultivated paper concept has a name/voucher identity conflict.

phyllary.note: No missing concept guarantees a positive reduction in optional transition edges across all four posture states, so the operational target switches to resolving the currently ambiguous root-state set.

stickiness.note: JPN_10 has the same robust localization gain as JPN_24 but carries an NCBI/tree-code naming caution, so JPN_24 is the clean operational first target.

observed_state_validation.cross_module_reason: JPN_36 is a terminal forced-change target in orientation (20.1%), phyllary (75.4%) and stickiness (40.0%) across bootstrap topologies; validate the source-backed states on Japanese voucher/population material before treating those placements as biological history.
observed_state_validation.stickiness_second_reason: JPN_06 is a forced stickiness-change terminal in 67.0% of bootstrap topologies.

next_module_expansion_gate.display: Do not add to historical overlap tests until a denser set of exact Japan38 concepts shares one directly comparable display metric; first fill the five high-leverage taxa listed above.
next_module_expansion_gate.colour: A 14/38 exact continuous colour bridge is recovered. Next run a continuous-trait phylogenetic pilot with count/dispersion sensitivity; do not enter colour into the discrete overlap test until a justified state ontology exists. Broad species phenotypes must not be assigned to paper varieties.
next_module_expansion_gate.principle: A fourth module is added only when trait states are directly comparable, concept identity is resolved, and its uncertainty can be propagated across the Japan38 topology ensemble.

tree_dependency: Resolved for the current compatibility analysis: frozen 241 locus universe -> 236 current QC loci -> 176 safflower-rootable loci -> 40-tip, 161654-bp IQ-TREE2.4.0 ML analysis. JPN_20 biological samples are non-monophyletic in the ML tree and 0/1000 UFBoot trees; because JPN_20 is fully unresolved for the three analysed traits it is pruned rather than forcibly collapsed. JPN_31 remains excluded from primary trait analysis because of the Japan/Ukraine identity conflict.
claim_boundary: Independent Japan38 compatibility reconstruction and source-backed trait lower bounds only; sampling priorities are inferential design heuristics, not probabilities of biological importance; display is not yet a Japan38 history module; colour has an exact 14/38 continuous bridge but is not yet a discrete transition module; not the unpublished Moreyra final-350 phylogeny, not adaptive-convergence counts, and not proof of developmental modularity or adaptive radiation.
